guard.name: Spec Guard
guard.description: Deterministic pre-implementation gates: every requirement is claimed by a task, the plan's Constitution Check matches the ratified constitution, and no capability is registered as supported before its handler exists
guard.author: son1122

converge-loop.name: Converge Loop
converge-loop.description: Run /speckit.converge after every /speckit.implement, and keep alternating implement → converge until the feature converges, with a bounded iteration count and no-progress detection
converge-loop.author: son1122
